notes.title: 24-09-08 Reduced the difficulty of revealing story mode in Level 2!
notes.content:
24-09-08 Although tangled, but still reduced the difficulty of revealing story mode in Level 2!

- Added more hints to reveal the story mode of the second level, further reducing player confusion
- Fixed some bugs in the revealed story mode in Level 2
- Move the horn position of the first level so as not to see it

If the second level does not reduce the difficulty, then those who can not pass the second level will have time to refund. This is one of the reasons why I don't want to lower the second level. The possibility of reducing the difficulty of the second level is that if the player has reached the fourth or fifth level, it is likely that he has missed the refund time, will not be able to refund, and is likely to play bad reviews. But after entanglement, or reduce the difficulty of the second level, of course, the strength of the player can choose a higher difficulty, but unfortunately, there is no special achievement in choosing a higher difficulty.
